column1: # The device tree the iPad's own iBoot hands its kernel on the emulator (KBootIBootTests), beside the IPSW's.
# Captured from a prepared k48ap base booted as the app boots it (iboot=, with -gdb and -S added): a breakpoint at the
# kernelcache's entry, r0 the boot_args, the tree at its deviceTreeP. The identity is UnitIdentity.synthesize's for
# the seed ipad1-<build>-default, the base's own; its values are recorded as digests.
# node <TAB> property <TAB> the IPSW's value <TAB> iBoot's. A property repeated in a node is name#2.
# IPSW: hex; =N, N bytes that neither iBoot nor KBoot changes or reads, not recorded; -, absent.
# iBoot: hex; =, the IPSW's; -, absent; sha256:, an identity value's digest.
